blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—After a stellar showing last year, T-Mc Ongotan picked up right where he left off and led Arellano to an opening win in the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament on Monday. Coach Chico praised Manabat for leading the way despite missing some time due to a hamstring injury. “He’s a leader for this group. He (Ongotan) got injured in the preseason, so he did a lot of catching up, but thank God he recovered right away. We saw the will of his preparation,” Manabat said after his team’s 98-72 rout of San Sebastian in Group B. READ: NCAA Season […]...
